notes.title: Aetherspace v 1.3.3 - Platform update and a few bug squished
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that caused enemy ships to perform an Immelman entering the battle... thus exiting the battle right away.
- Tweaked the code for the Ion Pulser. This should fix an issue where it ended up affecting its own user.
- Updated the engine to the latest Unity version. Shouldn't change anything, but it had to be done.
